title: Watersound 77 Shore Bridge Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Private Heated Pool and Sitting Spa **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day *The pool and spa are heated together- Professionally Decorated- 5 adult bikes- Grill- Golf Cart- Carriage House- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*This property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: 77 Shore Bridge is a comfortable 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom WaterSound home with a Carriage House that sleeps 12. Guests will love the private pool and sitting spa, screened porches, 6-seater golf cart, and the tranquil beauty of WaterSound. A deep front porch with rocking chairs and wooded views welcomes guests to the home. Stepping inside, guests will discover a professionally decorated open living, dining, and kitchen space with honey-colored wood floors and white shiplap walls. A wrap-around couch and chairs face a 65” TV and gas fireplace. 2 doors open from the living area to a screened side porch with an outdoor dining table. A light and airy kitchen has marble countertops, premium appliances, a 6-burner gas cooktop and range, and room for 3 at the dine-in island. A primary bedroom has a king bed, a Life Fitness exercise bike, and a private bathroom with a shower. A screened back porch overlooks a beautiful pool deck and wooded backyard. Adirondack chairs surround a pool with a sun shelf and sitting spa. A gas grill and outdoor dining table make dining beneath the stars simple. A home office with a wrap-around desk and a cozy sitting area is found at the second-floor stair landing. The sitting area has games and books stacked next to a comfy sofa and a 50” TV. A guest bedroom with a queen bed shares a bathroom with a shower with the home office and sitting area. A second guest bedroom has a queen bed and a private bathroom with a shower. A primary bedroom has a king bed and a private bathroom with double vanity and shower. Guests staying in the Carriage House will enjoy an inviting living and kitchen area with blue and white striped bean bags, a queen sleeper sofa, and a fully stocked kitchen. This small but mighty kitchen includes Keurig and standard coffee makers, a 4-burner gas cooktop, dishwasher, microwave, and an under-the-counter refrigerator. The guest bedroom has a king bed and shares a bathroom with a shower/tub combo with the living area. With the 6-passenger golf cart and 5 included adult bikes, it is easy and fun to explore WaterSound, go to the beach, or head over to The Big Chill for dinner or a concert. Book 77 Shore Bridge for your next beach vacation. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubCARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Living Room: Queen Sleeper*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs, not to exceed the weight limit of 25 lbs each, for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.*Please note that there is active construction next door to this home.
